name: Greater Wild Shape
description:
You must have Wild Shape to gain this ability.

When you use Wild Shape, you may transform into any non-humanoid creature of up to Challenge 5 that you have seen.

Describe your transformation.

improvements.name: Superior Wild Shape
improvements.description: When you use Wild Shape, you may transform into any non-humanoid creature of up to Challenge 10 that you have seen.

improvements.name: Shapechanger
improvements.description: When you use Wild Shape, you do not need to concentrate to sustain it, and you may sustain it for up to 1 day. During that time, you may shift between forms any number of times, as a half action.

improvements.name: Animal Shapes
improvements.description: You may spend 1 minute casting Wild Shape as a ritual. If you do, you may target any number of willing creatures within short range with the spell, paying 1 MP for each creature other than yourself and transforming them into any non-humanoid creature of up to Challenge 5 that you have seen.
